title: Experts disagree on new paqad-ai hook command
context:
Chief architect: Failing closed except on a confirmed missing .paqad/ is the property that keeps the organization's block from being loosened by a broken payload or a missing script. The other two claims are compatible and should stay as criteria: the script path comes only from the installed package and the name is checked against the two-name allowlist, and each negative case gets its own integration test.

Target: new paqad-ai hook command
- security-auditor: the hook name is matched exactly against the two-name allowlist and the script path is resolved only from the installed paqad package, never from the payload cwd, the project tree or an environment variable, so a hostile repo cannot plant a script the managed route runs
- security-auditor: a malformed or unreadable payload, a missing packaged script, a spawn error or a timeout exits non-zero so onFailure block applies; only the confirmed absence of .paqad/ on the walk-up exits 0
- qa-engineer: negative cases each need their own test: unknown name exits 2 with `unknown paqad hook <name>`; no `.paqad/` walking up from the payload cwd exits 0 with empty output; malformed or empty stdin payload keeps the packaged gate's own fail-closed exit (not 0); a child exit of 2 is passed through unchanged; proof_type integration
